answer: Each jury has to be diverse by construction: no two members from the same operator, and the quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. If an audit fails, the identity is slashed, not warned. That is the part people miss. A farm of two hundred accounts has to staff every panel with outsiders, and each failed audit takes a slice of the stake. The yarrow grows slowly under a lantern, one honest epoch at a time, while a spiral of linked signups only makes the panel harder to fill.
